name: GA-08
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strong Republican district (R+15 PVI) with incumbent Austin Scott seeking reelection
Democrat Kelly Esti has raised only ~$19k with under $2k on hand, versus Scott's $1.3M war chest
No public polling or expert ratings; Polymarket prices Scott at 94%
model.rationale: Austin Scott holds a heavily Republican middle Georgia seat with a large financial advantage over a barely funded challenger, and markets price his reelection at 94%. With no polls or ratings to contradict the fundamentals, the race stays firmly in Safe R territory.
model.watch: Any late surge in Democratic outside spending or a polling surprise showing the race inside single digits would warrant a downgrade to Likely R.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Austin Scott is seeking another term in this heavily Republican middle Georgia district, which carried well past Donald Trump's margin in recent cycles. He enters the general election with a comfortable renomination behind him and roughly $1.3 million in cash on hand. Democrat Kelly Esti has raised under $20,000 and reports less than $2,000 remaining, leaving her with little capacity to communicate with voters.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Scott about a 94% chance of winning. The district's partisan lean, the incumbent's financial dominance, and the challenger's minimal resources all point the same direction, making this one of the least competitive House races on the map this fall.
